'''Vekka Lodik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nuknog/Legends|Nuknog]] who served as the personal assistant of the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] actor [[Seboca/Legends|Seboca]]. During a botched attempt to murder her employer, she was killed by the detective [[Slyther Bushforb/Legends|Slyther Bushforb]].<ref name="DB" />
